description: Three charts stacked on one page, each still showing a readout at a different data point (Page B / pv 1398, Page D / pv 3908, Page A / pv 2400) even though focus has moved on to the button at the top of the page. Only one element can hold focus at a time, so at most one readout should be visible; all three are. Each one is frozen wherever it was left, which is what marks them as leftovers rather than live values.
